relationships.subject: ACC excitatory neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: ACC optogenetic activation increased the activity of DHNs regarding mechanical stimuli

relationships.subject: 6-OHDA ADHD model
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blotting of the ipsilateral dorsal spinal cord revealed an increased expression of the excitatory marker CaMKIIα in 6-OHDA mice

relationships.subject: muscimol
relationships.evidence_quote: Muscimol partially blocked the electrical activity of contralateral DHNs in the sham and 6-OHDA groups

key_findings: ACC hyperactivity in 6-OHDA ADHD mice drives spinal dorsal horn sensitization via the ACC-posterior insula pathway.
6-OHDA mice show increased spinal homer 1, CaMKIIα, pERK and pCREB.
